inputs.name: rooms
inputs.doc: The known list of rooms.

inputs.name: today
inputs.doc: The earliest bookable date; the date cannot be in the past.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.doc: Length in minutes: 30, 60 or 90.

inputs.name: invitees
inputs.doc: Email addresses of the people invited.

inputs.name: normalizeInvitee
inputs.doc: Trims a typed address and returns null to refuse text that is not an email address.

inputs.name: errors
inputs.doc: Per-field messages after a failed submit; each is empty when the field is fine.

inputs.name: summaryErrors
inputs.doc: Every problem in form order, each with the id of its field; empty until a submit fails.

inputs.name: isBooking
inputs.doc: True while the booking is being made.

inputs.name: onSubmit
inputs.doc: Validates and books; the container ignores it while isBooking.

props.title: Book a room
props.description: Reserve a meeting room for your team discussion.

props.label: Invitees
props.description: Press Enter or comma after each email address.

props.label: Note
props.description: Optional. Added to the invitation.

document.name: IncidentsScreen
document.purpose: Lets an on-call engineer search, filter, sort and delete the incidents their services raised.

inputs.name: incidents
inputs.doc: The incidents matching the current filters, already ordered by the container (newest first by default).

inputs.name: columns
inputs.doc: Title, service, severity, status, opened (sortable) and a delete action column; cell renderers use Badge, RelativeTime and Button members.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.doc: The current sort; opened descending by default.

inputs.name: search
inputs.doc: Current title search text.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.doc: Selected severity, null for all.

inputs.name: status
inputs.doc: Selected status (open or resolved), null for all.

inputs.name: isFiltered
inputs.doc: True while any search or filter is set.

inputs.name: onClearFilters
inputs.doc: Clears search, severity and status at once.

inputs.name: resultCount
inputs.doc: How many incidents match.

inputs.name: isEmpty
inputs.doc: True when there is nothing to list.

inputs.name: emptyState
inputs.doc: Filtered dry: says no incident matches, with a clear-filters secondary action. Otherwise: no incidents at all, a different message.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: True while an incident is awaiting delete confirmation.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: Question naming the incident, e.g. Delete "Checkout latency spike"?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: States that the incident is permanently deleted and cannot be undone.

document.name: IncidentsScreen
document.purpose: Lets an on-call engineer triage incidents: search, filter, sort by when they opened, and delete one after confirming it by name.

inputs.name: incidents
inputs.doc: The incidents matching the current filters, already ordered. Newest first by default.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.doc: Title, service, severity (Badge), status (Badge), opened (RelativeTime, sortable) and a row action that asks to delete that incident.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.doc: The current sort; the container starts it as opened-at descending.

inputs.name: query
inputs.doc: The title search text.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.doc: The chosen severity, or null for all.

inputs.name: status
inputs.doc: The chosen state (open or resolved), or null for both.

inputs.name: isFiltered
inputs.doc: True while a search or any filter is set.

inputs.name: onClearFilters
inputs.doc: Clears the search and every filter at once.

inputs.name: resultCount
inputs.doc: { shown, total } for the incidents matching the filters.

inputs.name: isEmpty
inputs.doc: True when there are no rows to show.

inputs.name: emptyTitle
inputs.doc: Different wording for no matches than for no incidents at all.

inputs.name: emptyDescription
inputs.doc: For no matches, says to change or clear the filters; for no incidents, says none have been raised.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: True while a delete is awaiting confirmation.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: The question, naming the incident, such as: Delete incident “API latency spike”?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: The consequence, naming the incident and saying it cannot be undone.

document.name: WorkspaceSettings
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner adjust general, notification and access settings that apply instantly, with a guarded danger zone for ownership transfer and deletion.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.doc: Current workspace name.

inputs.name: onWorkspaceNameChange
inputs.doc: Called when the name is committed.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.doc: IANA time zone dates are shown in.

inputs.name: timeZoneOptions
inputs.doc: Time zones to choose from.

inputs.name: digestEnabled
inputs.doc: Whether members get an email digest.

inputs.name: digestFrequency
inputs.doc: 'daily' or 'weekly'.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyOptions
inputs.doc: The options daily and weekly.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyDisabled
inputs.doc: True while the digest is off.

inputs.name: membersMayInvite
inputs.doc: Whether members may invite other people.

inputs.name: transferOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the transfer dialog is open.

inputs.name: memberOptions
inputs.doc: Members other than the owner who could become owner.

inputs.name: newOwnerId
inputs.doc: The member chosen to receive ownership.

inputs.name: onTransferOwnership
inputs.doc: Transfers ownership to the chosen member.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: Question naming the workspace, e.g. Delete Acme?

inputs.name: onDeleteWorkspace
inputs.doc: Deletes the workspace and every project in it.

document.name: WorkspaceSettings
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner adjust general, notification and access settings that apply immediately, and take the two irreversible actions of transferring or deleting the workspace.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.doc: Current workspace name.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.doc: IANA zone id of the zone dates are shown in.

inputs.name: timeZoneOptions
inputs.doc: Time zones to choose from.

inputs.name: digestEnabled
inputs.doc: Whether members get an email digest.

inputs.name: digestFrequency
inputs.doc: 'daily' or 'weekly'.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyDisabled
inputs.doc: True while the digest is off, so its frequency cannot be set.

inputs.name: membersMayInvite
inputs.doc: Whether members may invite other people.

inputs.name: transferOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the transfer-ownership dialog is open.

inputs.name: transferCandidates
inputs.doc: Members the workspace could be handed to, other than the owner.

inputs.name: transferTo
inputs.doc: Member id chosen as the new owner, or null.

inputs.name: onTransferConfirm
inputs.doc: Transfers ownership to the chosen member.

inputs.name: onTransferCancel
inputs.doc: Closes the transfer dialog.

inputs.name: transferConfirmDisabled
inputs.doc: True until a member is chosen.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the delete confirmation is open.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: Question naming the workspace, e.g. 'Delete Acme Design?'.

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Says the deletion is irreversible, names the workspace and states that every project in it is deleted too.

inputs.name: onDeleteConfirm
inputs.doc: Deletes the workspace.
